what_happened: The job was meant to stop 405 responses on pending-check merges from firing D87's hard signal. It was rejected at the final verdict. Two of 6 acceptance criteria were unmet. (1) The CHANGELOG entry and the note that D87 excludes the 405 false positive. (2) The criterion that fmt, clippy and the full cargo test pass. There was one blocker: the job edited the D87 entry in place in docs/decisions.md, which breaks the append-only decision log, and the guard in decisions.rs:217-241 makes cargo test fail at docs/decisions.md:1917. One check failed, and it is a check, not a criterion: `test`. That failing check is what backs the unmet cargo test criterion. The D87 note criterion was unmet because the way it was written (an in-place edit of D87) is forbidden. The code fix itself is not reported as faulty.
cause: The accepted reading required that D87 be annotated, and nothing checked that criterion against the repo's append-only rule for the decision log. That rule is enforced by a test, but the producer was not told that decisions can only be superseded or appended to, and nothing ran the guard before the final verdict. Only the final verifier runs the full suite, so the contradiction between the criterion and the invariant surfaced as a rejection. This is an inference, since the stored fields do not show the reading or the plan.
prevention: At reading acceptance, run a code check that scans criteria and deliverables for edits to append-only files (docs/decisions.md existing entries, records/) and refuses or rewrites them as appending a new decision that supersedes or amends D87. Also have the producer run the decisions guard test before reporting, so an in-place edit is caught early.
proposed_request: Stop pending-check merge 405 responses from firing D87's hard signal. Outcome: a 405 returned because a merge was attempted while required checks are still pending is treated as a pending state, not as the hard signal, and the existing 405 method-not-allowed derivation test still passes. Record the decision by appending a new decision entry to docs/decisions.md that amends D87 and references it. Do not edit the D87 entry or any existing entry in place, because the decision log is append-only and the guard in crates/athena-cli/src/decisions.rs enforces it. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry naming the pending-check 405 false positive and stating that existing records/ are untouched. Acceptance: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass, with the commands and their output cited in the report; a watcher test shows a pending-check 405 does not fire the hard signal while a genuine 405 still does.
